name: @gemmein/mcp
description: Gemmein MCP server — gives coding agents the Gemmein guide, API reference, rule/error explainers, and a live integration check (reaffirm) as tools. Eight tools are read-only; check_integration writes test people and a probe record in the app's development environment; if a private collection is open to strangers, its anonymous test write succeeds and stays, in any environment, and the check fails, naming it.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && chmod +x dist/index.js
